turns.text: I'm Alex and welcome to the E2 task of the week.
turns.zh: 我是 Alex，欢迎来到本周的 E2 任务。

turns.text: What are we going to do today?
Today we are working on IELTS speaking.
turns.zh: 今天我们要练雅思口语。

turns.text: And in particular, we're going to practice part one of the tests.
turns.zh: 特别是，我们要练习考试的第一部分。

turns.text: Okay, and what are we going to do specifically Alex?
turns.zh: 好，那具体我们要做什么呢，Alex？

turns.text: Well, I'm going to start with a speaking test overview.
turns.zh: 嗯，我先从口语考试概览开始讲。
